units: FBX in cm: 1 m in Blender == 100 uu; scale 1.0 on import

axes.fbx_export: axis_forward=-Z axis_up=Y (Blender defaults; verified round trip via verify_fbx.py)

uv: UV 1.0 == 1 m (real-world scale); tile materials as UV / size_m
uv_note: box projection per face in metres; round parts cylindrical (u = arc length in m, v = axial metres)

street_light.pivot: ground level on the column axis (parapet-mount: underside of base plate)
street_light.bracket_axis: +Y in mesh space; rotate by StreetLight.heading (rad CCW from +x, direction the bracket points) so +Y maps to heading
street_light.heading_to_yaw: mesh +Y == bracket direction; yaw_about_Z = heading - pi/2 (mathematical CCW; mirror for Unreal's left-handed Y as needed)
street_light.mounting_height_m: luminaire centre height above the base == StreetLight.mounting_height
street_light.on_structure: use mesh_on_structure (_PM: flat bolted plate, no door/root) when StreetLight.on_structure
